title: wmux settings
description: Settings for wmux.json and the shared cmux.json. Keys use cmux names; wmux-only keys live under "wmux".

$schema.description: Schema URL for editor completion (the wmux or the cmux schema).

schemaVersion.description: Config format version; newer versions are read best effort.

packs.description: Local pack files or directories loaded before this file, relative to it unless absolute. A directory resolves to wmux.pack.json, then cmux.pack.json.
